datasets.name: CelesTrak GP mean element sets (CCSDS OMM keywords, CSV): published groups, special data sets and NAME searches
datasets.organization: CelesTrak (T.S. Kelso); data from U.S. Space Force 18th/19th Space Defense Squadrons via Space-Track.org
datasets.purpose: SGP4 mean elements for every tracked on-orbit object rendered and propagated in the Earth orbital-environment layer; CelesTrak group memberships for filters (stations, constellations, GNSS, GEO, debris clouds, ...).
datasets.mechanism: HTTPS GET gp.php?{GROUP|SPECIAL|NAME}=...&FORMAT=CSV (OMM keywords, 9-digit-safe) -> merged by NORAD_CAT_ID (latest EPOCH wins, group tags unioned) -> catalog.json rows with elementSource="celestrak-gp".
datasets.query: GROUP={active,fengyun-1c-debris,cosmos-2251-debris,iridium-33-debris,analyst,last-30-days,stations,visual,weather,resource,sar,sarsat,dmc,tdrss,argos,planet,spire,geo,intelsat,ses,eutelsat,telesat,oneweb,qianfan,hulianwang,kuiper,iridium-NEXT,orbcomm,globalstar,amateur,satnogs,x-comm,other-comm,gnss,gps-ops,glo-ops,galileo,beidou,sbas,science,geodetic,engineering,education,military,radar,cubesat}&FORMAT=CSV (46 requests); SPECIAL={GPZ,GPZ-PLUS,DECAYING}&FORMAT=CSV; NAME=DEB&FORMAT=CSV; NAME=R/B&FORMAT=CSV. Starlink group intentionally not downloaded (subset of active per CelesTrak).
datasets.version: live archive state at retrieval (GP downloads 2026-10-16T18:29:34.217Z .. 2026-10-17T06:50:38.227Z; CelesTrak GP update cycle current as of 2026-10-16 18:05:42 UTC)
datasets.license: No formal open-data licence. CelesTrak makes the data freely available to all users subject to its usage policy (https://celestrak.org/usage-policy.php). The GP/OMM element sets and SATCAT are "basic SSA data" originating from USSPACECOM (U.S. Space Force 18th/19th Space Defense Squadrons) via Space-Track.org, for which USSPACECOM grants "express blanket approval for transfer/redistribution of basic SSA data ... conditioned on appropriate citation" (Space-Track User Agreement, section "Redistribution of Basic SSA Information").
datasets.citation: Orbital data: CelesTrak (Dr T.S. Kelso, https://celestrak.org) - GP element sets and SATCAT; source data: U.S. Space Force 18th & 19th Space Defense Squadrons / USSPACECOM via Space-Track.org.
datasets.rateLimits: CelesTrak usage policy (2026-05-22): download each data set at most once per update (GP every 2 h, SupGP 2 h, SATCAT 1-2x per day); since 2026-03-26 a repeat request for GP Active/Starlink before the next update returns HTTP 403; stop querying on any non-200 (301/403/404/5xx); >50 HTTP errors in 2 h or >100 MB/day may get the IP firewalled; directory/query pages at most once per hour. No per-second limit documented (this pipeline waits 2.5 s between requests).
datasets.updateCadence: Upstream refresh every 2 h. Cosmos snapshot refreshed manually: node scripts/data/orbital/fetch.mjs --refresh && node scripts/data/orbital/build.mjs (never more than once per upstream update).
datasets.cachePolicy: versioned offline snapshot; optional online refresh
datasets.fallback: If catalog.json is missing or fails to parse, hide the orbital-object layer and show "orbital catalog unavailable" (never synthesize objects). Per object: hasElements=false -> render from SATCAT shape with illustrative phase and label it reconstructed; elementSource=null -> list only, do not render.
datasets.limitations: GP elements are SGP4 mean elements (TEME, UTC epochs) with ~1 km accuracy at epoch degrading by km/day; ages differ per object (median 1.14 d at retrieval). 3813 of 35652 on-orbit objects have no public GP in the downloaded sets (no group covers inactive payloads; ~800 objects are NEA "no elements available", e.g. classified; others have no current GP at CelesTrak) and fall back to SATCAT shape. 594 analyst objects (uncorrelated tracks, numbers 8xxxx / 2xxxxx) are included as class "unknown". The tracked catalogue (~10 cm LEO / ~1 m GEO detection limits) is a small fraction of the real debris population (ESA MASTER-8: ~1.5 million objects 1-10 cm).

datasets.name: CelesTrak Satellite Catalog (SATCAT), full CSV
datasets.organization: CelesTrak (T.S. Kelso); catalog maintained by U.S. Space Force 18th SDS, with CelesTrak corrections
datasets.purpose: Authoritative list of on-orbit objects (no decay date, Earth-centred): object class, owner, launch date/site, RCS, operational status, docking; orbit shape (apogee/perigee/inclination/period) for objects without GP elements; population statistics by class/regime/altitude shell.
datasets.mechanism: HTTPS GET of the static full-catalog CSV -> filter DECAY_DATE empty and ORBIT_CENTER = EA (or docked to an Earth-orbiting host) -> joined with GP by NORAD_CAT_ID.

datasets.cachePolicy: versioned offline snapshot; optional online refresh
datasets.fallback: Without SATCAT the app cannot show owner/class/launch metadata; render GP objects with class from name heuristics only and flag metadata as unavailable.
datasets.limitations: SATCAT apogee/perigee/period/inclination are rounded (km, 0.01 deg/min) and can be stale for objects without current elements. RCS (m^2) is missing for ~58% of on-orbit objects (rcsSize null). OWNER is the SATCAT source code (country/organisation), not necessarily the operator. Analyst objects are not in SATCAT.

datasets.name: Derived on-orbit population statistics (class, regime, 50-km shells, spatial density, notable objects)
datasets.purpose: Kessler / debris laboratory: real-catalog shell populations and spatial densities; HUD counts; notable-object shortcuts.
datasets.mechanism: Computed locally by build.mjs from the catalog rows (no separate download): regime classification, mean-altitude histogram, residence-time-weighted shell occupancy and spatial density; external reference figures (ESA, CelesTrak boxscore) quoted for context.
datasets.license: No formal open-data licence. CelesTrak makes the data freely available to all users subject to its usage policy (https://celestrak.org/usage-policy.php). The GP/OMM element sets and SATCAT are "basic SSA data" originating from USSPACECOM (U.S. Space Force 18th/19th Space Defense Squadrons) via Space-Track.org, for which USSPACECOM grants "express blanket approval for transfer/redistribution of basic SSA data ... conditioned on appropriate citation" (Space-Track User Agreement, section "Redistribution of Basic SSA Information"). Derived statistics: cite as below.
datasets.citation: Orbital data: CelesTrak (Dr T.S. Kelso, https://celestrak.org) - GP element sets and SATCAT; source data: U.S. Space Force 18th & 19th Space Defense Squadrons / USSPACECOM via Space-Track.org. Statistics computed by the Cosmos project. Context figures: ESA Space Debris Office (sdup.esoc.esa.int/discosweb/statistics, 2026-10-14) and CelesTrak SATCAT boxscore (2026-10-15).
datasets.cachePolicy: versioned offline snapshot; optional online refresh
datasets.fallback: If summary.json is missing, the app may recompute counts from catalog.json; hide shell-density charts otherwise.
datasets.limitations: Shell statistics use mean (not osculating) apsides and a two-body residence-time model; satcat-shape rows use rounded SATCAT apsides. Only the tracked public catalogue is counted (objects >~10 cm in LEO); real densities including untracked debris are far higher.
